task1: A WSI of No RAS/BRAF mutation colorectal cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of relatively organized gland-forming tumor regions, conventional adenocarcinoma growth patterns, moderate architectural distortion, variable but not dominant mucinous areas, and tumor borders showing expansile or moderately infiltrative growth into the surrounding stroma.
task2: A WSI of No MSI colorectal cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of conventional gland-forming adenocarcinoma architecture, relatively cohesive tumor regions, moderate desmoplastic stromal response, limited Crohn-like lymphoid reaction, less prominent intratumoral lymphocytic infiltration, and invasive tumor margins without dense lymphoid aggregates.

task1: A WSI of RAS/BRAF mutation colorectal cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of irregular infiltrative tumor growth, heterogeneous glandular and solid tumor regions, prominent desmoplastic stromal reaction, mucin-rich or serrated-like architectural areas, poorly defined tumor margins, and variable lymphocytic infiltration around invasive tumor fronts.
task2: A WSI of MSI colorectal cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of prominent lymphocyte-rich tumor regions, Crohn-like lymphoid aggregates at the invasive margin, mucinous or medullary-like growth patterns, pushing or expansile tumor borders, heterogeneous tumor architecture, and reduced or variable desmoplastic stromal reaction.

task1: A WSI of No RAS/BRAF mutation colorectal cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of well-formed or moderately formed malignant glands, columnar tumor cells with enlarged hyperchromatic nuclei, nuclear stratification, dirty necrosis within glandular lumina, limited mucinous or serrated differentiation, and variable stromal inflammatory cell infiltration.
task2: A WSI of No MSI colorectal cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of malignant glandular structures lined by atypical epithelial cells, elongated hyperchromatic nuclei, nuclear stratification, dirty necrosis, relatively sparse tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and limited direct interaction between lymphocytes and tumor epithelial cells.

task1: A WSI of RAS/BRAF mutation colorectal cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of poorly formed or irregular malignant glands, tumor cells with enlarged pleomorphic nuclei, increased nuclear atypia, extracellular mucin pools or serrated glandular morphology, scattered single-cell invasion or tumor budding, and mixed inflammatory cells interacting with tumor nests.
task2: A WSI of MSI colorectal cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of dense tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, lymphocytes intermingled with malignant epithelial cells, poorly differentiated or medullary-like tumor areas, mucinous differentiation, enlarged pleomorphic tumor nuclei, conspicuous inflammatory microenvironment, and frequent tumor-immune cell contact.
